audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10 fits 48.33% over 1794 games: Aurora owns 1-5 on range (900 vs 625/725) and level 6 flips to Katarina on Death Lotus, then flips back on first item.
All four spikes are grounded: 3-5 range dominance, 6 Death Lotus at 75s with Grievous Wounds plus Voracity resets, first item while R is still 75s, late the counter-ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullets repeat the trade lines under unrelated titles; the Grievous Wounds interaction never reaches the Don'ts where it decides whether to keep fighting.
audit.why: Death Lotus applies healing reduction, so Spirit Abjuration cannot refill you mid-fight — that is the reason to disengage at half HP rather than greed the recast. Death Lotus is a channel and Between Worlds' shockwave is hard CC, already stated across tldr and late.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to their own titles, with the anti-heal fact carried into the Don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief flags Bouncing Blade as grounding.
audit.why: Riot's text describes only a bouncing dagger that lands on the ground — no dash denial. Nothing was written asserting it, per the description-wins rule.
audit.corrected: No edit; flag treated as a tooltip-parse misfire.
